Vendor bill live post (₹100.00) fanned into the balanced legs correctly: `trial_balance_paise` stayed at 0 pre/post, vendor.subledger_paise and vendor.gl_control_paise moved together (drift stayed 0). This directly re-verifies the F1 reconciliation invariant after the import-order edit.
